text:
ops-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT P1: archipelago-prod (VPC) — tool/function-calling failures detected. Error spike at 14:03 UTC. Auto-page to #eng-oncall. Service: tool-runner; affected tenant: archipelago (dedicated pool). Stack: parser/runner v2. Attempts: 500s and parser exceptions.

rachel: on it. @kevin @samira can you take first triage? I'll loop in account-ops after we have impact numbers.

kevin: taking. Looking at logs now. grabbing last 100 errors for archipelago.

kevin: ```
2026-03-14T14:02:58Z ERROR tool-runner archipelago request_id=abc123 ParserError: Unexpected token '}' at 124 in tool_payload.json
2026-03-14T14:02:59Z ERROR tool-runner archipelago request_id=abc124 ToolCallTimeout: 30s exceeded
2026-03-14T14:03:01Z WARN gateway archipelago 502 upstream truncated response
```

samira: hmm looks like a schema drift — the customer started sending an extra field in the tool payload (meta.context) that our new parser v2 treats as invalid. We shipped a stricter validation in v2 two weeks ago.

archipelago-sre: confirming — we deployed a client-side sdk change at ~13:55 UTC that adds meta.context. We didn't expect server-side validation to reject it. Impact: ~12% of toolcall requests failing for our tenants during the spike.

rachel: customer impact estimate noted. Account team should prep a status update: @account-ops can you draft comms after we stabilize?

account-ops: standing by. we'll want ETA and whether there's data loss or retries.

kevin: immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) route archipelago traffic to parser-legacy (old runtime) — quick config change in routing table, no code deploy.
2) set permissive flag `REDWOOD_TOOL_PARSER_LEGACY=true` for tenant runtime env — quick restart of worker nodes for that tenant.
3) disable tool-calling for archipelago at proxy level — guaranteed rollback to text-only, reduces functionality.

samira: option 1 looks safest and minimal blast radius. I can update routing to point archipelago to `parser-legacy` pool for the next 30m. Need kube labels and routing key: `tenant:archipelago` -> `runtime:parser-legacy`.

kevin: doing it now. running: 
```
# update routing rule
redwoodctl route update --tenant archipelago --runtime parser-legacy --namespace prod
```

ops-bot: Action triggered: `route update` by kevin at 14:08 UTC. ChangeID=chg_77a9d. Auto-rollout watchers notified.

kevin: confirmed rollout succeeded. 3 pods behind parser-legacy serving archipelago. Latency stable, error rate dropping.

archipelago-sre: seeing failures drop from 12% -> 0.9% in the last minute. Good. Can you keep it routed for 1 hour while we patch parser?

samira: I'll open a hotfix PR to relax validation and deploy v2.1 that accepts `meta.context` as optional. target: 30m.

rachel: account-ops can start a short notice: "We experienced transient toolcall errors for archipelago customers; mitigation in place, engineering working on fix". No data loss observed, retries are succeeding.

account-ops: drafting now and will send to AMs once we confirm stability for 5 minutes.

kevin: side note — we observed a backlog of queued request tokens for archipelago. I flushed queue after routing change to avoid double-processing. Command: `redwoodctl queue flush --tenant archipelago --grace 10s`

ops-bot: Queue flush executed by kevin. 420 items requeued safely.

samira: PR opened: `relax-parser-validation` -> CI green. Deploying canary to 2 pods in prod archipelago pool (not parser-legacy) now.

samira: canary looks good for 5m no errors. proceeding with staged rollout to remaining pods (10m windows).

kevin: monitoring metrics: 5xx down to baseline, tool latency unchanged. Good.

archipelago-sre: we can keep parser-legacy as backstop but prefer to get v2.1 live so other tenants don't run legacy runtime. We'll coordinate a clean cutover when all pods at v2.1.

rachel: handoff FYI — I have to step out at 14:45 UTC. @ben you free to own the incident until close? ben is on-call backup.

ben: I can take it. I'll monitor rollout and confirm cutover. Assigning postmortem owner: ben.

ops-bot: Incident status changed to: Mitigated at 14:23 UTC. Immediate mitigation: routing to parser-legacy. Root cause suspected: strict validation in parser v2 incompatible with new client payload field. Customer impact: partial (12% requests) for ~20 minutes.

ben: final checklist —
- Confirm v2.1 fully rolled out to archipelago pool.
- Remove temporary routing override once stable.
- Draft postmortem and include customer timeline + communication for AMs.

samira: v2.1 fully rolled out at 14:40 UTC. Tests green. I'll open a revert for the routing override in 10m unless we see regressions.

archipelago-sre: thanks for the fast turnaround. We'll keep monitoring on our side and will coordinate postmortem items.

ben: I'll close the incident after we remove the override and account-ops confirms comms went out. Postmortem will be assigned to me, targeted publish: EOD tomorrow.

rachel: thanks everyone for the quick mitigation. Assigning follow-ups: 
- samira: validation PR and compatibility tests (in progress)
- kevin: queue safety doc updates (in progress)
- ben: postmortem + customer timeline (todo)

ops-bot: Note: Handoff complete. Next steps logged under CHG chg_77a9d and INC inc_88421. If any regression, re-alert will be triggered. :white_check_mark:
